reviews.title: Unexpected Charge and Unclear Subscription Terms
reviews.text:
I’m very disappointed with this experience. The app did not clearly communicate that I was signing up for a paid subscription or that I would be charged $53.11 after the free trial. I was not expecting this charge, and I would not have agreed to it had the subscription terms and pricing been clearly presented to me.

I contacted the app’s support team, but they directed me to Apple to request a refund. Unfortunately, my refund requests were denied twice.

I believe subscription prices and automatic charges should be clearly disclosed so customers can make informed decisions. A free trial should not leave customers surprised by a significant charge just a few days later.

I hope the developers improve the way they communicate subscription terms and pricing so other customers do not have the same experience. Please make your subscription terms clear and transparent before charging your customers.
